bio: Raffaele was baptized on 27 August 1821, son of Luigi Colosimo and Carmela Moraca ([R4-S1]). He married Filippina Iera on 24 March 1839, aged only 17 ([R4-S2]). They had at least ten children between 1840 and 1866, including John's ancestor Saveria (1848) ([R4-S5]). Filippina died in 1871. In October 1872 Raffaele remarried Maria Luigia Rametta (indexed as Barretta at a son's 1873 baptism) ([R4-S3], [R4-S5]). He was buried at San Mango on 18 January 1899 ([R4-S4]). The burial gives his age as 89, but by his baptism he was 77.
